notes: Ambient occlusion in a 3D cab (docs/tasks/renderer/23-ambient-occlusion.md, "Radius in a 3D cab"): CMK's New Activity1 (file1.act, the player's cd3dcabtest in a Czech 3D cab) two seconds after its 12:00 start, the camera at the cab's head. 'cab' the cab standing; 'move' the head moved 10 cm a frame towards the desk (to the cab's 0.5 m limit), each frame saved. With TSRE_AO_DEBUG=1 the occlusion term alone: its halos keep their size on the desk as the head moves. Run with --game-root <the MSTS folder with CMK> --route CMK --set core.rendering.ambientOcclusion=2 --set core.rendering.timeOfDay.running=false.
